overview: A rising stand-up comedian who built her career on jokes about her estranged, washed-up father reunites with him to farm new material, only for their uneasy stage collaboration to unearth painful family wounds.
tagline: Sometimes the loudest laughter comes from the deepest wounds.
title: Comedy Buddy
